concerns.text: T012a and T012b (Data Fetch) are listed as prerequisites for T013 (Metadata Parsing), but T013 explicitly requires T042 (Uncertainty Parser) which is marked as a Foundational task. However, T013's description says 'parse TGA model/precision from source metadata using T042'. If T042 is foundational, it should be ready. The real issue is T013b: it requires T012a/b AND T043. T043 (Uncertainty Propagator) is foundational. The flow is: Fetch (T012) -> Parse Metadata (T013) -> Propagate Uncertainty (T013b). T013b depends on T013 output. This is correct. However, T014 (Feature Engineering) depends on T013b output for 'T_d_uncertainty' column? No, T014 computes descriptors. T013b writes 'T_d_uncertainty' to descriptors.csv. T014 writes to descriptors.csv. T014 must run BEFORE T013b if T013b appends to the file, or T013b must run after T014 to add the column. The task T013b says 'write T_d_uncertainty column to data/processed/descriptors.csv'. T014 says 'write output to data/processed/descriptors.csv'. If T014 runs first, T013b can append. If T013b runs first, T014 overwrites. T013b requires T012a/b (data) and T043 (logic). T014 requires T012a/b (data). T014 does NOT require T013b. T013b requires T014? No, T013b requires T012a/b and T043. But T013b writes to the SAME file as T014. This is a race condition/dependency violation. T014 must complete before T013b writes the final column, OR T013b must be part of T014. Currently, T013b is a separate task that depends on T012a/b but not T014. If T013b runs before T014, it writes a file without descriptors. If T014 runs before T013b, it overwrites T013b's work. T013b must depend on T014.

T014b (Derive perovskite_family) requires T014 output. T020 (Model Training) requires T014b output. This is correct. However, T013b (Uncertainty) also writes to descriptors.csv. T014b writes to descriptors.csv. T014 writes to descriptors.csv. T013b, T014, T014b all write to the same file. T013b depends on T012a/b. T014 depends on T012a/b. T014b depends on T014. T013b does NOT depend on T014. If T013b runs before T014, the file is incomplete. If T014 runs before T013b, T013b overwrites. T013b must depend on T014 to ensure the descriptor columns exist before adding the uncertainty column.

T020 (Model Training) requires T014b and T013b. T014b depends on T014. T013b depends on T012a/b and T043. T014 depends on T012a/b. The dependency chain is: T012a/b -> T014 -> T014b. T012a/b -> T013b. T020 requires T014b AND T013b. This implies T014 and T013b must both complete before T020. However, T013b and T014 both write to descriptors.csv. T013b must run AFTER T014 to append the uncertainty column to the descriptor file. T013b currently only depends on T012a/b and T043. It must also depend on T014 (and T014b) to ensure the file is fully populated before adding the final column.

T030 (Load held-out data) requires T025 (Save trained models). This is incorrect. T030 is about loading external literature data for validation. It does not depend on the trained models (T025). It depends on the existence of the literature data source. T030 should not depend on T025. T031 (OOD detection) depends on T025 (model) and T017 (dataset). T030 is independent of T025. The dependency 'Requires: T025' is a semantic error; T030 can run in parallel with T025 or before T025, as long as the literature data is available.

T031 (OOD detection) requires T025 (model) and T017 (dataset). T017 is the final processed dataset. T017 depends on T014b and T013b. T025 depends on T020. T020 depends on T014b and T013b. This is correct. However, T031 also requires T017. T017 is the final dataset. T031 uses T017 to check for elements/motifs. This is correct. But T031 also uses T025 (model) for prediction distance. T025 depends on T020. T020 depends on T014b/T013b. T017 depends on T014b/T013b. So T031 depends on T020 and T017. T020 and T017 are parallel branches from T014b/T013b. This is correct.

T013b description: 'write T_d_uncertainty column to data/processed/descriptors.csv'. T014 also writes to 'data/processed/descriptors.csv'. T014b also writes to 'data/processed/descriptors.csv'. The task order must ensure T014 runs first, then T014b, then T013b (or T013b is merged into T014). Currently, T013b does not depend on T014, creating a risk of file overwrite or incomplete data. Add 'Requires: T014' to T013b.

T014b description: 'write to data/processed/descriptors.csv'. T014 also writes to the same file. T014b depends on T014. This is correct. T013b also writes to the same file. T013b must depend on T014b (or T014) to ensure the file is complete before adding the uncertainty column. Add 'Requires: T014b' to T013b.
